# [CS081] Use time.Since (go.style.time-since)

time.Now().Sub(t) computes the elapsed time.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | INFO |
| **Category** | Style |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | Yes |

## Why It Matters in Go

time.Since(t) is the idiomatic form of time.Now().Sub(t) and reads as what it measures. The fix rewrites the expression.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
elapsed := time.Now().Sub(start)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
elapsed := time.Since(start)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [go.style.time-since]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    go.style.time-since: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore go.style.time-since -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** go.style.time-since
```
